description: Residue composition at BBS10 catalytic positions across orthologs: test whether any lineage restores the catalytic aspartates
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
from collections import Counter
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
seqs=json.load(open("bbs10/seqs.json")); HUM=seqs["BBS10_HUMAN"][2]; L=len(HUM)
AL=json.load(open("bbs10/ortholog_alignment.json"))
full={k:v for k,v in AL.items() if v["cov"]>=0.85*L}
trunc={k:v for k,v in AL.items() if v["cov"]<0.85*L}

POS={50:"NDG-loop Asp equivalent (GroEL D52 / Mm-cpn D60)",
     81:"GDGTT Asp (Mm-cpn D91)",83:"Mm-cpn T93",84:"Mm-cpn T94",85:"Mm-cpn T95",
     181:"catalytic Lys (Mm-cpn K161 / GroEL K51-type)",
     412:"helix preceding the catalytic-Asp register",416:"catalytic Asp equivalent (Mm-cpn D386 / GroEL D398)"}
print("Residue composition at the six catalytic/Mg positions plus flanks\n"
      "(full-length orthologs; truncated models listed separately only where they cover the column)\n")
rec=[]
for p,desc in POS.items():
    obs={k.split('|')[0]:v["map"].get(str(p)) for k,v in full.items()}
    obs={k:v for k,v in obs.items() if v}
    obs_t={k.split('|')[0]:v["map"].get(str(p)) for k,v in trunc.items()}
    obs_t={k:v for k,v in obs_t.items() if v}
    c=Counter(obs.values()); ct=Counter(obs_t.values())
    acidic=sum(n for a,n in c.items() if a in 'DE'); acidic_t=sum(n for a,n in ct.items() if a in 'DE')
    rec.append(dict(pos=p,human=HUM[p-1],desc=desc,n=len(obs),
                    composition=",".join(f"{a}:{n}" for a,n in c.most_common()),
                    n_acidic=acidic, trunc_cov=len(obs_t),
                    trunc_composition=",".join(f"{a}:{n}" for a,n in ct.most_common()) or "-",
                    n_acidic_trunc=acidic_t))
    print(f"{HUM[p-1]}{p:<4} {desc}")
    print(f"      full-length (n={len(obs):2d}): {dict(c.most_common())}   Asp/Glu count = {acidic}")
    if obs_t: print(f"      truncated   (n={len(obs_t):2d}): {dict(ct.most_common())}   Asp/Glu count = {acidic_t}")
    print()
df=pd.DataFrame(rec); df.to_csv("bbs10/ortholog_catalytic_composition.csv",index=False)

# decisive summary
restore=df[(df.pos.isin([50,416]))]
print("Restoration test: does any BBS10 ortholog carry Asp/Glu at the two lost catalytic positions?")
print(f"  position 50  : {int(restore[restore.pos==50].n_acidic.iloc[0]+restore[restore.pos==50].n_acidic_trunc.iloc[0])} of "
      f"{int(restore[restore.pos==50].n.iloc[0]+restore[restore.pos==50].trunc_cov.iloc[0])} orthologs")
print(f"  position 416 : {int(restore[restore.pos==416].n_acidic.iloc[0]+restore[restore.pos==416].n_acidic_trunc.iloc[0])} of "
      f"{int(restore[restore.pos==416].n.iloc[0]+restore[restore.pos==416].trunc_cov.iloc[0])} orthologs")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(11,4.2))
labels=[f"{r.human}{r.pos}" for r in df.itertuples()]
cons=[max([int(x.split(':')[1]) for x in r.composition.split(',')])/r.n for r in df.itertuples()]
acid=[r.n_acidic/r.n for r in df.itertuples()]
x=np.arange(len(df))
ax.bar(x-0.2,cons,0.4,color='steelblue',label='fraction carrying the modal vertebrate residue')
ax.bar(x+0.2,acid,0.4,color='firebrick',label='fraction carrying Asp or Glu')
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([f"{l}\n{d.split('(')[0].strip()}" for l,d in zip(labels,df.desc)],fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_ylabel('fraction of 15 full-length orthologs'); ax.set_ylim(0,1.08)
ax.set_title('BBS10 nucleotide-site positions across vertebrate orthologs: substitutions are fixed, not polymorphic')
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='upper center')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
